name: After § 32
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2024
part_text: 54a. Notes that Parliament’s administration found that at least EUR 4 333 635.78 of budget item 400 appropriations were unduly spent by the former Identity and Democracy group over the 2019-2024 term, and that the EPPO opened an investigation in July 2025 into the alleged misuse of Union funds by the group; stresses that the credibility of the Union’s anti-fraud architecture requires the consistent application of transparency, accountability and recovery measures to all beneficiaries without exception; calls on Parliament’s administration, in parallel with the EPPO’s criminal investigation, to take administrative interim protective measures towards the Union’s financial interests; considers that the dissolution of the Identity and Democracy group in 2024 and the resulting financial proceedings have demonstrated that the current framework is inadequate to ensure timely detection, reporting and recovery; calls on Parliament’s Bureau to urgently review and strengthen the internal financial control framework applicable to the political groups in the European Parliament;
